title: Valid email is accepted and redirects to the thank-you page
steps: Scroll to the site-wide footer newsletter signup form
expected_result: Browser performs a full-page redirect to `/thanks-for-subscribing-to-our-newsletter/`, displaying "Thank you for signing up for our newsletter" and "Be on the look for an email from us." A stale default inline confirmation may flash briefly during the AJAX-to-redirect transition on slow loads — note this if observed, but it does not affect pass/fail.

title: Empty email submission is rejected with a required-field error
steps: Scroll to the site-wide footer newsletter signup form
expected_result: Form displays the error "There was a problem with your submission. Please review the fields below."; no redirect to the thank-you page occurs.

title: Malformed email format is rejected with a format error
steps: Scroll to the site-wide footer newsletter signup form
expected_result: Form displays the error "There was a problem with your submission. Please review the fields below."; no redirect to the thank-you page occurs.

title: Whitespace-only value in the email field is not accepted as valid
steps: Scroll to the site-wide footer newsletter signup form
Enter three space characters in the email field
expected_result: Submission is not treated as successful — the form displays the error "There was a problem with your submission. Please review the fields below."; no redirect to the thank-you page occurs.

title: Plus-addressed valid email is accepted like any other valid address
steps: Scroll to the site-wide footer newsletter signup form
expected_result: Same success behavior as a plain valid address — full-page redirect to `/thanks-for-subscribing-to-our-newsletter/` with the standard thank-you messaging.

title: XSS/script-injection string in the email field is not executed
steps: Scroll to the site-wide footer newsletter signup form
expected_result: No JavaScript executes (no alert dialog); the payload fails email-format validation and the form displays the standard invalid-email-format error, same as TC-NEWSLETTER-SIGNUP-003. No redirect occurs and no server error is triggered.
